amendment_policy: never; any correction, retry, or reseal requires a new parent-authorized namespace

historical_executor_note.shadow-eval: exercised by the holdout-shadow-eval goal node

reader_authority.result_embargo: release neither aggregate result until both reader processes terminate

sources.capture_watermark_rule: trusted launcher current UTC instant recorded at readiness process launch before any source open

predicate.population: source-qualified union of every recall event present in either exact immutable snapshot

selection.missing_family_identity_action: create no automatic-family edge and contribute to no automatic-family floor
selection.missing_session_action: create no session/workflow edge and contribute to no session/workflow floor

identity.key: one fresh ephemeral 256-bit key for complete frozen-dev automatic reference and all candidate automatic events

public_dev_corpus.reason: independently de-identified query surrogates cannot establish cross-build equality

raw_identity_reference.kind: operator-resolved read-only original alt recall-event export pinned by the frozen original manifest; not a candidate source alias
raw_identity_reference.processing: opened only inside the same isolated HMAC process and under the same fresh key as candidate identities
raw_identity_reference.persistence: no raw field, identity, HMAC token, or per-event result persists
raw_identity_reference.unavailable_or_hash_mismatch: fatal readiness integrity failure; no surrogate or alternate reference

complete_frozen_dev_reference.population: all automatic events selected by the frozen original split declaration from the raw identity reference

repeated_automatic_family.identity: same source_alias plus equal ephemeral HMAC token; identical queries in distinct source authorities are distinct runtime families

identity.unseen_in_dev: family token absent from the complete frozen-dev automatic reference
identity.sealed_packet_equality_labels: fresh opaque random surrogates unrelated to HMAC output, confined to the sealed corpus

component_edges: shared source-qualified automatic identity equality class for every automatic event, regardless of whether the class later qualifies as a repeated family
shared nonempty source-qualified transport_session_id, which is also the workflow key
partition.component_representative: lexicographically smallest source_alias UTF-8 + NUL + event_id UTF-8 byte string

readiness.project_scope_predicate: requested_scope starts with the exact bytes 'project:'
readiness.workflow_definition: one source-qualified nonempty transport_session_id originally recorded in a read-only production source

workflow_provenance_predicate.organic_anchor: at least one selected event in the source-qualified workflow has agent IS NOT NULL
workflow_provenance_predicate.origin: row is present in the recall_events table of an immutable local or alt production snapshot

readiness.real_workflow_proxy: production-snapshot origin plus nonempty source-qualified transport_session_id plus organic anchor plus at least one replayable call is the sole source-blind genuine-workflow predicate; no content or undeclared synthetic classifier is allowed
readiness.workflow_counts_only_if: contains at least one replayable logical call; final evidence requires at least one complete measured pair in every counted workflow
readiness.logical_call_definition: one unique source-qualified eligible recall event; baseline and candidate observations form one pair

replay_input_schema.event_id: nonempty source identifier structurally validated, then replaced by an opaque packet-local event label
replay_input_schema.query: nonempty string preserved only as a sealed de-identified surrogate
replay_input_schema.requested_scope: source string replaced by an equality-preserving packet-local scope label that retains only the global/session:/project: kind prefix
replay_input_schema.agent: nullness preserved; non-null values replaced by packet-local equality-preserving agent labels in the sealed de-identified replay envelope
replay_input_schema.task: nullness preserved; non-null values replaced by packet-local equality-preserving task labels in the sealed de-identified replay envelope
replay_input_schema.session_id: nullness preserved; non-null values replaced by packet-local equality-preserving session labels in the sealed de-identified replay envelope
replay_input_schema.transport_session_id: nullness and equality preserved by packet-local workflow labels; nonempty source value required for workflow eligibility
replay_input_schema.initial_state: hash-bound LM state contains every opaque referenced node required by the call

readiness.replay_envelope_location: hash-bound de-identified case record inside the sealed partition only; raw caller values exist only in the keyed build process and are destroyed before manifest publication
readiness.replayable_call_definition: all fields in replay_input_schema required for its cohort validate before implementation
readiness.measured_call_definition: one replayable logical call with complete baseline and candidate payload, access, provenance, and latency instrumentation
readiness.ready_action: seal both complete deterministic partitions from the exact readiness snapshot pair
readiness.insufficient_action: emit aggregate gap, publish no packet, begin no repair implementation, and close v2

candidate_plan.name: private deterministic v2 candidate build plan
candidate_plan.hash: candidate_plan_sha256 is SHA-256 of the canonical private plan bytes
candidate_plan.persistence: plan bytes never persist; readiness and publisher independently regenerate the same hash from the exact snapshot pair

a_priori_power_floor.scope_generalization: at least two project scopes independently in holdout and shadow

measurement.design: paired baseline and candidate executions over identical ordered logical calls
measurement.point_estimate_population: complete eligible population in the reader's partition
measurement.reference_behavior: gating-off behavior from the same frozen stack and ordered inputs

cohorts.unseen_repeated_automatic: every holdout automatic event belonging to a repeated family that is absent from the complete frozen-dev automatic reference
cohorts.organic: every selected holdout event with source classification agent IS NOT NULL
cohorts.agent_triggered: every organic cohort event, replayed with agent-triggered provenance fixed in the pre-candidate replay envelope; candidate-emitted provenance cannot change membership
cohorts.shadow: every shadow replayable logical call; incomplete post-run pairs fail the evidence floor and are not removed
cohorts.novel_node_opportunity: for each unseen repeated-automatic family in canonical event order, each opaque node present in the gating-off delivery that has not appeared in any earlier gating-off event of that family; all nodes in the first event are novel

measurement.content_access_opportunity: one opaque event-node pair in the gating-off delivery; candidate access is preserved only when the same opaque node is inline with nonempty content or its content_ref passes the isolated resolver protocol

content_ref_resolver.phase: after every primary timed recall call in both arms has completed
content_ref_resolver.environment: fresh isolated read-only clone of the corresponding arm's pre-call sealed node state
content_ref_resolver.operation: invoke the normal frozen MCP memory_lookup path once per unique opaque content_ref and reduce the response to a boolean resolvable-or-not value
content_ref_resolver.receipt_binding: resolver code, configuration, and initial-state SHA-256 and bytes

measurement.content_bearing_delivery: the same opaque node is present in the candidate delivery with nonempty inline node content; a stub or content_ref alone is not content-bearing

serialized_character_measure.value: decoded content member of the MCP tool-result envelope for the logical call
serialized_character_measure.serialization: Python json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False) with default separators and insertion order under the hash-bound runtime
serialized_character_measure.count: Python len of the resulting Unicode string

latency_measure.start: immediately before dispatch of the MCP recall request
latency_measure.stop: immediately after the complete MCP response is received and parsed
latency_measure.empirical_quantile: sort all complete paired-call arm values ascending and select index max(0, ceil(p * n) - 1), independently for p=0.50 and p=0.95

state_isolation.state_granularity: one seed state per partition and source alias
state_isolation.seed_source: the exact readiness snapshot for that source alias

construction.schema: fresh database created by the hash-bound pre-repair packet-state builder
construction.all_other_source_tables_or_columns: not copied; any required extra field is a protocol mismatch and fatal preseal failure
construction.recall_events: empty at seed; no pre-cutoff or candidate recall event is copied
construction.manifest: hash-bind schema, table allowlist, per-table aggregate counts, and complete seed-state bytes

state_isolation.gating_off_and_candidate: separate byte-identical pre-open clones of the partition/source seed state; each implementation performs only its normal hash-bound migration before calls
state_isolation.shadow_and_holdout: separate fresh state clones with no shared mutable database, automatic history, session state, cache, or process
state_isolation.arm_execution: each isolated arm executes every call once in the same canonical order
state_isolation.reset_rule: never reuse a clone across source aliases, partitions, readers, or arms
receipt_bindings: gating-off clone SHA-256 and bytes before execution
candidate clone SHA-256 and bytes before execution
process and cache initialization configuration SHA-256

arm_schedule.order: if SHA-256(digest_input)[0] & 1 == 0 dispatch gating-off then candidate, else candidate then gating-off
arm_schedule.publication: computed before implementation from the private source-qualified key and stored only as a one-bit dispatch-order field in the sealed case
arm_schedule.evaluator_input: the reader consumes only the sealed one-bit dispatch-order field and never needs the destroyed raw event key or mapping
arm_schedule.barrier: both paired responses complete before either arm advances to the next canonical event

metric_definitions.unseen_repeated_automatic_character_redu: 1 - sum(candidate serialized_character_measure) / sum(gating-off serialized_character_measure) over the unseen_repeated_automatic cohort
metric_definitions.automatic_content_access: count(content_access_opportunity preserved by candidate) / count(content_access_opportunity in gating-off) over the unseen_repeated_automatic cohort
metric_definitions.organic_payload_delta: sum(candidate serialized_character_measure) / sum(gating-off serialized_character_measure) - 1 over the organic cohort
metric_definitions.organic_access_delta: count(content_access_opportunity preserved by candidate) / count(content_access_opportunity in gating-off) - 1 over the organic cohort
metric_definitions.agent_triggered_delivery: count of paired agent_triggered cohort calls whose raw MCP tool-result content bytes differ; required value is zero
metric_definitions.novel_nodes_content_bearing: count(novel_node_opportunity with content_bearing_delivery in candidate) / count(all novel_node_opportunity); zero denominator is invalid
metric_definitions.shadow_latency_p50_degradation: nearest-rank candidate empirical p50 / nearest-rank gating-off empirical p50 - 1 over the shadow cohort
metric_definitions.shadow_latency_p95_degradation: nearest-rank candidate empirical p95 / nearest-rank gating-off empirical p95 - 1 over the shadow cohort

unseen_repeated_automatic_character_redu.cluster_unit: connected component containing a qualifying unseen automatic family

automatic_content_access.cluster_unit: connected component containing a qualifying unseen automatic family

organic_payload_delta.cluster_unit: connected component containing a selected organic event

organic_access_delta.cluster_unit: connected component containing a selected organic event

agent_triggered_delivery.cluster_unit: connected component containing a selected organic event

novel_nodes_content_bearing.cluster_unit: connected component containing a qualifying unseen automatic family

shadow_latency_p50_degradation.cluster_unit: connected component containing a counted shadow workflow

shadow_latency_p95_degradation.cluster_unit: connected component containing a counted shadow workflow

measurement.parent_gates_outside_this_node: preserved unchanged; downstream registries must match these literals and be hash-bound, and this plan neither replaces nor weakens them

sampling.cluster_order: opaque connected-component label UTF-8 byte order ASC
sampling.replicate_estimator: recompute the exact corresponding full-sample metric formula over the sampled component multiset with multiplicity

uncertainty.seed_derivation: uint32be value of SHA256(namespace UTF-8 + NUL + seed label UTF-8)[0:4]
uncertainty.invalid_replicate_action: report count and set interval null if count is nonzero; because uncertainty is supplementary, this never changes the parent full-sample point-gate result

forbidden_in_prompts_logs_diagnostics_or: query or content surrogates outside sealed corpus
raw event identifiers or event labels outside sealed corpus
family membership or per-family sizes outside sealed corpus
session or workflow identifiers outside sealed corpus
raw individual case records or de-identified case records outside sealed corpus
sealed_corpus_only_allowance: freshly de-identified outcome-free case records with query and content surrogates required for replay
fresh opaque packet-local event, node, family, scope, agent, task, session, and workflow equality labels unrelated to HMAC output

preserve: space, tab, newline, and carriage-return positions
bijective equality classes within one build

packet_manifest_must_bind: partition/source seed states and state-construction manifest
evaluation_receipts_must_bind: clean repair Git commit and tree
partition initial-state and pre-execution arm-clone hashes
content_ref resolver code, configuration, and isolated state
